causal_engine_specifications.exogenous_trace_generation: Pre-generated policy-independent task arrival traces using dedicated RNG stream per scenario
causal_engine_specifications.finite_buffers: Finite FIFO/EDF buffers (capacity=5) per IoT device with overflow tracking and unsatisfied ledger records
causal_engine_specifications.task_lifecycle: PENDING -> ASSIGNED_UPLOAD -> UPLOADING / PAUSED_UPLOADING -> UPLOADED (staging) -> QUEUED (resident) -> IN_SERVICE -> COMPLETED_ON_TIME / EXPIRED
causal_engine_specifications.upload_binding: Immutable source-to-UAV binding; partial uploads pause upon connection loss without transferring bits to other UAVs
causal_engine_specifications.mobility_model: Piecewise continuous fly-then-hover: t_fly = min(Delta_t, ||Delta q|| / V_cr), t_hover = Delta_t - t_fly; no upload permitted during flight
causal_engine_specifications.boundary_promotion: Uploaded tasks in slot t enter resident onboard CPU queues exclusively at slot t+1
causal_engine_specifications.cpu_allocation: Discrete per-resident-job CPU frequency allocation bounded by F_m^max * phi_m(t)
causal_engine_specifications.radio_concurrency: Hard active link limit sum_i u_im <= K_m^comm (K_m^comm=3) and exclusivity sum_m u_im <= 1
causal_engine_specifications.cluster_targeting: Multi-UAV choice of identical cluster targets enabled (strict_exclusivity=False) with target-conditioned continuous guidance beta=0.35
causal_engine_specifications.objective_p1: Completion-aware mission-level T_svc calculated over ALL generated tasks (deadline + T_miss penalty for unsatisfied tasks); zero synthetic percentage fallbacks

paper_reference_parameters.area_geometry: Circular service area of radius R_area = 500 m

equal_budget_guarantee: All compared baseline algorithms evaluated within identical physical causal constraints, identical exogenous traces, and equal training budgets
